why: The park's own description, as carried on its Campendium listing (read 2026-10-30), says 'All RVs must be 30 ft. or longer, have a bathroom with a compatible sewer hookup, and display an RVIA sticker'. A 23-ft Class C fails that minimum rig length. Its own domain elmarrv.com is a Squarespace 'Coming Soon' parking page (2026-10-30), so nothing current from the operator overrides the rule.
name: El Mar RV Resort
flags: Skip reason: minimum rig length of 30 ft ('All RVs must be 30 ft. or longer ... no tents, pop-ups, or truck campers'). It comes from the park's description as Campendium carries it, and the operator's own page can't be read. RVezy says 'All RVs welcome / no max RV length', which is about the maximum and doesn't contradict it. Campendium and Google reviews report only 37-45 ft rigs (2019-2025). If AWH calls the park (305-294-0857) and it takes a 23-ft Class C, it could be re-vetted.

No live presence of its own: elmarrv.com (Google's and Campendium's listed site) is a Squarespace 'Coming Soon / under construction' page on 2026-10-30, and the 2019 Wayback captures of that domain are unrelated Chinese spam pages. Hipcamp shows an unclaimed 'Coming soon to Hipcamp, contact for pricing' placeholder. There is no booking site and no posted rate. Only the last camper-reported rate exists: $99 in July 2019. Google Maps at the pin shows it open, with a phone and 4.4/92, and Google reviews from 11 months ago confirm it still operates. So presence would pass on Google, and price on RV Life $$$$ (Keys rule).
Possible long-stay park: an October 2021 Campendium comment says Dec 1-Apr 15 was booked through 2024, and one 2022 reviewer stayed 35 days. It is small, about 11 sites.
Waterfront was not audited because of the skip. Reviews say some sites back onto the water (site 7, 'great view of the water'), at the south shore of Stock Island.
